name: Thai Minced Pork Wraps (Laab Salad) with Cucumber, Basil & Chili

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 limes
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 red chili peppers
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince shallots and garlic; place in a medium bowl.
Trim green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces and add to the bowl with the shallot and garlic.
Juice half the limes into the bowl. Cut remaining limes into wedges and transfer to a large plate; set aside.
Add oil, vinegar, fish sauce, and soy sauce to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup toasted sesame oil
⅓ cup rice vinegar
⅓ cup fish sauce
⅓ cup soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add ground pork and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until starting to brown, 4-5 minutes.
Pour ⅓ of the dressing over the pork and stir to combine; bring to a simmer and cook for another 2-3 minutes. Remove skillet from the heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice cucumbers into rounds; add to the plate with the lime wedges.
Pick basil leaves off the stems and add to the plate.
Trim and thinly slice chili peppers into rounds; add to the plate. (Be careful, with chilies, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Divide pork, lettuce leaves, lime wedges, cucumbers, basil, and chili peppers between plates. Serve with remaining dressing on the side for dipping and enjoy!
